newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.3 Sept 6 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 106.3 Sept 6 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) rose to 106.3 in the week ended September 6 from a revised 105.3 the previous week, ECRI said.

A slight rise in the growth rate of real estate loans and a drop to a seven-year low in the insured unemployment rate contributed to the sharp rise of the inflation gauge, according to ECRI. The smooth growth rate of industrial materials prices also contributed to the rise, ECRI said.

"The latest week's figures show the FIG rising sharply on the strength of the marked drop in the insured employment rate. The FIG has risen nearly two points over the last five weeks, suggesting that disinflationary pressures have practically disappeared," ECRI said.
